CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetBaseTagList

Returns the names of the active custom tags, innermost first. Called inside a custom tag, the first name is the current tag itself, followed by its ancestors.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetBaseTagList()

Returns

An upper-case list such as "CF_ITEM,CF_ORDER". Outside any custom tag the list is empty.

Usage

Custom tags appear as CF_ followed by their name; tags called through CFMODULE appear as CFMODULE. Built-in tags such as CFOUTPUT and CFLOOP are not listed in KoldFusion.

A child tag can use ListFindNoCase(GetBaseTagList(), "CF_ORDER") to check that it was placed inside its parent before calling GetBaseTagData.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT><P>In the page itself: "#GetBaseTagList()#"</P></CFOUTPUT>
<!--- the last column of each row is GetBaseTagList() called inside sn_sysitem.cfm --->
<CF_SN_SYSORDER CUSTOMER="Grace Hopper">
  <CF_SN_SYSITEM PRODUCT="Bug (moth, slightly used)" QTY="1">
  <CF_SN_SYSITEM PRODUCT="Nanosecond wire" QTY="12">
</CF_SN_SYSORDER>
